root_cause: The dropdown's dataApiKeydownHandler handles the Escape key unconditionally, calling preventDefault() and stopPropagation() even when the dropdown menu is closed. This prevents the Escape event from propagating to the modal's dismissal handler, so the modal does not close when pressing Escape on the dropdown toggle while the menu is closed.
repair_strategy: Modify the dropdown's dataApiKeydownHandler to only handle Escape (and call preventDefault/stopPropagation) when the dropdown is active (i.e., the toggle has the 'show' class). When the dropdown is not active, allow the Escape event to propagate so the modal can handle it. Move the isActive computation earlier and conditionally handle Escape.
expected_accessibility_effect: Escape key will correctly close the dropdown menu when it is open, and close the modal when the dropdown menu is closed, aligning with WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard), 2.4.3 (Focus Order), and 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value).
functional_risks: Minimal; only changes dropdown keyboard behavior for Escape key. Could affect other dropdowns on the page, but the change is scoped to Escape key handling when the dropdown is not active.
verification_requirements: Run the provided journey tests (including the regression guard) to ensure Escape closes the modal when dropdown is closed, and closes only the dropdown when open.
Verify that ArrowUp/ArrowDown and Space keys still work as expected for dropdown navigation.
Test with multiple dropdowns on a page to ensure no regression.
